## Ruling needed: the whole-file lint gate blocks every remaining L2 lane

`.oxlintrc.json:17-25` (merged in #771) lints STAGED FILES WHOLE and states the
backlog "is paid per-file as work naturally touches them". L2b-1 (#779)
measured what that costs on the files rung L2 has to touch, and the answer is
that the rewiring cannot land without first paying the debt in four files.

### What happened

- #778 (L2a) landed the schema half: 23 env names typed on `ServerConfig`.
- #779 (L2b-1) landed four tool readers taking config, but the composition-root
  half (`server/main.ts:168` passing the values into `registerMemoryTools`)
  could not be committed: `server/main.ts` carries 3 pre-existing violations
  and the hook refuses any commit that stages the file. Review found two P1
  start-equivalence breaks caused by exactly that missing half
  (https://github.com/rodaddy/open-brain/pull/779#issuecomment-5424424539).
  #779 is a draft until this is settled.
- L2b-2 (shared-namespace, 25 call sites), L2c (main.ts, tracing, capture) and
  L2d all touch the same files.

### The debt, measured against clean `origin/main` (`49ecfbe`)

```
server/main.ts:207:8   complexity              -- async fn `startServer`, complexity 22 (max 10)
server/main.ts:207:8   max-lines-per-function  -- async fn `startServer`, 140 lines (max 100)
server/main.ts:421:24  max-params              -- `shutdown`, 5 params (max 4)

server/tools/search-brain.ts:77:8   max-lines-per-function -- `registerSearchBrainTool`, 142 lines (max 100)
server/tools/search-brain.ts:155:5  complexity             -- async fn, complexity 18 (max 10)

server/tools/search-all.ts:136:33  max-params              -- `searchQmdInternal`, 5 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-all.ts:237:19  max-params              -- `searchQmd`, 5 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-all.ts:285:8   max-lines-per-function  -- `registerSearchAllTool`, 203 lines (max 100)
server/tools/search-all.ts:344:5   complexity              -- async fn, complexity 19 (max 10)
server/tools/search-all.ts:344:5   max-lines-per-function  -- async fn, 142 lines (max 100)

server/tools/search-engine.ts:404:24   max-params -- `buildVectorCTE`, 5 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-engine.ts:460:21   max-params -- `buildFtsCTE`, 6 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-engine.ts:538:28   max-params -- `vectorSearch`, 7 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-engine.ts:598:25   max-params -- `ftsSearch`, 8 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-engine.ts:756:37   max-params -- `executeSearchInternal`, 9 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-engine.ts:848:30   max-params -- `executeSearch`, 9 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-engine.ts:1023:8   complexity -- async fn `executeSearchWithSharedFallback`, complexity 11 (max 10)
server/tools/search-engine.ts:1023:54  max-params -- `executeSearchWithSharedFallback`, 10 params (max 4)
server/tools/search-engine.ts:1097:23  max-lines  -- file, 837 code lines (max 500)
```

12 of 19 are `max-params` on the search stack (`executeSearch` has 55 refs
repo-wide). `search-engine.ts` also fails `max-lines`, so touching it at all
means splitting it, which is the L4 work the approved ladder
(`_plans/server-hardening-ladder.md:35-37,186-187`) places AFTER L2/L3 so each
file is split once. `server/observability/langfuse-tracing.ts` (982 code
lines) is in the same position for L2c.

### Options

- **O1 (recommended): pay the debt per file, as its own lane, right before the
  rewiring lane that needs the file.** `main.ts` first (extract from
  `startServer`, options object for `shutdown`; behavior-preserving, existing
  tests unmodified), which unblocks #779's wiring commit. Then
  `search-brain.ts` / `search-all.ts` (extract the handlers). Then
  `search-engine.ts` and `langfuse-tracing.ts` as L4 pulled forward for those
  two files only, split along the charter seams. Re-touching a split file for
  config and logging later is small edits, not a second split, so the
  "split once" reason for the L4 ordering does not hold against the gate.
- **O2: teach `_githooks/pre-commit` a baseline** so only added or changed
  lines in a touched file are linted. Deviates from L1's whole-file design and
  weakens the gate in exactly the files that most need it. Not recommended.
- **O3: run all of L4 (five files) before resuming L2.** Larger up-front, same
  end state as O1 for the two files that need it, plus three that do not yet.

Ruling recorded in `_plans/server-rewrite-decisions.md` once made.
